تستهجنين (form X)
# تَسْتَهْجِنِينَ (tastahjinīna) /tas.tah.d͡ʒi.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# تُسْتَهْجَنِينَ (tustahjanīna) /tus.tah.d͡ʒa.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
